note: Virtual element — OOXML has no <w:col> child of <w:tbl>; the path is synthesized from <w:tblGrid>/<w:gridCol> + the per-row cell at column slot C. Same-table only for move/copy. Set/Get accept idColumn, noWrap, and width (including width=fit). Query at the column level is not supported. Insert is rejected when the column slot crosses a merged cell (gridSpan/vMerge) — unmerge first. Marking an ID column skips a merged cell that only covers the slot and errors when no single-span cell starts in that column.

idColumn.description: Mark this column as an ID column. true writes w:noWrap on every single-span cell that starts in the column and sets the column width (w:gridCol and those cells' w:tcW) to fit the longest line: max(18mm, longest × 2.0mm + 8mm). A Latin character counts as 1; a full-width character counts as about 1.8. Example: NFR-01 (6) → 1134 twips. false removes w:noWrap and leaves the width. An explicit width= on the same call is used instead of the fit. Other columns are not resized; a dxa table width shifts by the same delta. On a table path, pass the 1-based index instead (idColumn=1 or idColumns=1,3).
idColumn.readback: true when every single-span cell has w:noWrap and the grid width still matches the fit; otherwise absent

noWrap.description: Write or remove w:noWrap on every single-span cell that starts in this column. Does not change the width. Prefer idColumn=true when the column should also fit the longest line.
noWrap.readback: true when every single-span cell in the column has w:noWrap; otherwise absent

width.description: column width in twips (or any twips-parseable length). 'fit' or 'auto' sizes the column to the longest line using the same formula as idColumn, without changing wrap.

text.description: seed text inserted into every new cell of this column (one paragraph per cell).
